_comment: The kit's shared material base (parts factory, workflow step 3, pilot 1 KF-PORTAL-01). The quality principles of the SC etalon (Docs/Kit/etalon/etalon.md): a light lacquer, a polished light lip 15-20 mm that draws the outline in reflections, a dark third (matt rubber, satin graphite - the contrast mostly in roughness); plus the floor's anti-slip lanes. The maker's palette changes the lacquer and the dark tones, never the lip (author 6. 10. 2026, board round 2). Unreal: master /Game/Kit/Materials/M_Kit_Base (the layered master's graph, kit-only: hand-height band for edge wear and scratches, the walked line), instances MI_Kit_<Maker>_<Role> (Tools/Assets/import_kit.py build_factory_materials). Blender preview: Tools/Kit/kit_geo.py materials(). Limits checked by Tools/Tests/test_kit_materials.py.

limits._comment: FACTORY_WORKFLOW step 3, the etalon and the author's board review (6. 10. 2026): [min, max].

roles._comment: Per role: the colour (a palette key, or a fixed 'albedo' the maker cannot change), roughness, metallic, the surface detail and the wear switches. 'bevel_mm' = the bevel the parts give the role's edges (the edge wear is as wide). micro_rough / grunge / rough_variation / panel_rough / panel_tone / scratches feed the layered master's SurfaceDetail; scratches only in the hand band (ScratchBandOn).

Kit_Lacquer._why: satin, not paper (author, board round 2): the grain down ~70 % (micro 0.06 -> 0.018), a soft highlight at 0.47, a faint per-panel variation

Kit_Lip._why: a light polished silver for every maker, no brushing, with the variant c reflections

Kit_Graphite._why: satin graphite; scratches at half the old strength and only at hand height

Kit_Gasket._why: matt dark rubber with a fine grain (micro roughness) and the cuff's ribs as geometry

Kit_AntiSlip._why: today's kit tread pattern in the lanes (Tools/Kit/kit_tread_normal.py), the lanes only a little lighter than the field (lane_contrast_max); the walked line polished through roughness, not a dark stain

emissive._comment: Emissive roles of the factory parts (plain master): the L1 foot light's diffuser white with a blue tint (~7500 K), small and bright enough to bloom - not a saturated blue patch.

Halcyon._comment: Halcyon Freightworks (part.md KF-PORTAL-01 step 1b, author 6. 10. 2026: the frame all cream lacquer). Wear: a maintained working ship - dirt in the seams, edge wear only at hand and shoulder height, the walked line; no overall wear. edge_wear 1.0 / threshold 0.15: at 0.8 / 0.35 the 4 mm worn bevels did not show (board round 2).

Kestrel._comment: Kestrel Dynamics (kit-design.md proposal, not approved): a light grey-white lacquer, dark gunmetal, a blue accent; cleaner than Halcyon.
